entries.en: `--plugin-dir` now accepts `.zip` plugin archives in addition to directories
entries.zh: `--plugin-dir` 现在除了文件夹，还支持 `.zip` 格式的插件压缩包

entries.en: `--channels` now works with console (API key) authentication — console orgs with managed settings must set `channelsEnabled: true` to enable
entries.zh: `--channels` 现在支持 console（API key）认证；启用了托管设置的 console 组织需要设置 `channelsEnabled: true` 才能开启

entries.en: Headless `--output-format stream-json`: `init.plugin_errors` now includes `--plugin-dir` load failures in addition to dependency demotions
entries.zh: 无界面模式 `--output-format stream-json`：`init.plugin_errors` 现在除了依赖降级，还包含 `--plugin-dir` 加载失败的情况

entries.en: Bare `/color` (no args) now picks a random session color
entries.zh: 裸`/color`（无参数）现在选择随机会话颜色

entries.en: `/mcp` now shows the tool count for connected servers and flags servers that connected with 0 tools
entries.zh: `/mcp` 现在会显示已连接服务器的工具数量，并标记连接成功但工具数为 0 的服务器

entries.en: Updated `/model` picker: collapsed duplicate Opus 4.7 entries, and current Opus now shows as "Opus" instead of "Opus 4.7"
entries.zh: `/model` 选择器：合并了重复的 Opus 4.7 条目；当前的 Opus 现在显示为 "Opus" 而不是 "Opus 4.7"

entries.en: MCP: `workspace` is now a reserved server name — existing servers with that name will be skipped with a warning
entries.zh: MCP：`workspace` 现在是保留的服务器名称，已用该名称的现有服务器会被跳过并给出警告

entries.en: Reconnecting MCP servers no longer flood the conversation with full tool-name lists on every reconnect — re-announced tools are summarized by server prefix
entries.zh: MCP 服务器重连时，不再在每次重连时向对话里刷出完整的工具名列表，重新公布的工具会按服务器前缀汇总

entries.en: SDK hosts now receive a persistent `localSettings` suggestion for Bash permission prompts, so "Always allow" writes to `.claude/settings.local.json`
entries.zh: SDK 宿主现在会为 Bash 权限提示收到一个持久的 `localSettings` 建议，因此 "Always allow" 会写入 `.claude/settings.local.json`

entries.en: Auto mode: when the classifier can't evaluate an action, the error now includes a hint (retry, `/compact`, or run with `--debug`)
entries.zh: 自动模式：当分类器无法评估某个操作时，错误现在包含提示（重试、`/compact`或使用`--debug`运行）

entries.en: Subprocesses (Bash, hooks, MCP, LSP) no longer inherit `OTEL_*` environment variables, so OTEL-instrumented apps run via the Bash tool no longer pick up the CLI's own OTLP endpoint
entries.zh: 子进程（Bash、钩子、MCP、LSP）不再继承 `OTEL_*` 环境变量，因此通过 Bash 工具运行的、带 OTEL 埋点的应用，不会再误用 Claude Code 自身的 OTLP 端点

entries.en: `EnterWorktree` now creates the new branch from local HEAD as documented, instead of `origin/<default-branch>` — unpushed commits are no longer dropped
entries.zh: `EnterWorktree` 现在会按文档说明，从本地 HEAD 创建新分支，而不是 `origin/<默认分支>`；未推送的提交不再丢失

entries.en: Fixed focus mode briefly dimming the previous response when submitting a new prompt
entries.zh: 修复了提交新提示时焦点模式会暂时使之前的响应变暗的问题

entries.en: Fixed stray "4;0;" desktop notification on every `/exit` in Kitty and other terminals that interpret OSC 9 as a notification
entries.zh: 修复了杂散“4;0;” Kitty 和其他将 OSC 9 解释为通知的终端上的每个`/exit`上的桌面通知

entries.en: Fixed Remote Control showing an empty "Opening your options…" message on rate limit instead of actionable upsell options
entries.zh: 修复了远程控制在速率限制上显示空的“打开您的选项...”消息，而不是可操作的追加销售选项的问题

entries.en: Fixed drag-and-drop image upload hanging on "Pasting text…" when the image read fails
entries.zh: 修复了图像读取失败时拖放图像上传挂在“粘贴文本...”上的问题

entries.en: Fixed crash loop when piping very large input (>10 MB) to `claude -p` via stdin
entries.zh: 修复了通过标准输入将非常大的输入（> 10 MB）传输到`claude -p`时的崩溃循环

entries.en: Fixed long URLs not being individually clickable on every wrapped row in fullscreen mode
entries.zh: 修复了在全屏模式下每个包装行上无法单独单击长 URL 的问题

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin` Components panel showing "Marketplace 'inline' not found" for plugins loaded via `--plugin-dir`
entries.zh: 修复了通过 `--plugin-dir` 加载的插件显示“未找到市场‘内联’”的`/plugin`组件面板

entries.en: Fixed MCP tool results dropping images when the server returns both structured content and content blocks
entries.zh: 修复了当服务器返回结构化内容和内容块时 MCP 工具导致图像丢失的问题

entries.en: Fixed fenced code blocks inside list items carrying leading whitespace into the clipboard on copy-paste
entries.zh: 修复了列表项内的围栏代码块，在复制粘贴时将前导空格带入剪贴板

entries.en: Fixed tab navigation in `/config` stranding focus — the tab header now stays focused so arrows and Esc keep working
entries.zh: 修复了`/config`中搁浅焦点的选项卡导航 - 选项卡标题现在保持焦点，因此箭头和 Esc 继续工作

entries.en: Fixed markdown link labels being lost on terminals without OSC 8 hyperlink support — links now render as `label (url)` instead of just the URL
entries.zh: 修复了在没有 OSC 8 超链接支持的终端上丢失的 Markdown 链接标签 — 链接现在呈现为“标签（url）”，而不仅仅是 URL

entries.en: Fixed sessions on 1M-context models with a smaller autocompact window being falsely blocked with "Prompt is too long" before reaching the actual API limit
entries.zh: 修复了在达到实际 API 限制之前，具有较小自动压缩窗口的 1M 上下文模型上的会话被错误地阻止为“提示太长”的问题

entries.en: Fixed parallel shell tool calls: a failing read-only command (grep, git diff, ls) no longer cancels sibling calls
entries.zh: 修复了并行 shell 工具调用：失败的只读命令（grep、git diff、ls）不再取消同级调用

entries.en: Fixed banner showing "with X effort" on models that don't support effort
entries.zh: 修复了在不支持努力的模型上显示“X 努力”的横幅

entries.en: Fixed `/fast` on 3P providers fuzzy-matching to an unrelated skill instead of showing "not available"
entries.zh: 修复了 3P 提供商上的`/fast`与不相关技能的模糊匹配，而不是显示“不可用”

entries.en: Fixed Bedrock default model resolving to `global.*` instead of the region-appropriate prefix
entries.zh: 修复了基岩默认模型解析为`global.*`而不是适合区域的前缀

entries.en: Fixed vim mode: `Space` in NORMAL mode now moves the cursor right, matching standard vi/vim behavior
entries.zh: 修复 vim 模式：NORMAL 模式下的空格键现在会右移光标，与标准 vi/vim 行为一致

entries.en: Fixed terminal progress indicator (OSC 9;4) flickering off between tool calls — stays visible across the full turn
entries.zh: 修复终端进度指示器（OSC 9;4）在工具调用之间闪烁熄灭的问题，现在会在整个回合中保持可见

entries.en: Fixed `/rename` without args failing on resumed sessions whose last entry is a compact boundary
entries.zh: 修复了没有参数的`/rename`在最后一个条目是紧凑边界的恢复会话上失败的问题

entries.en: Fixed stale "remote-control is active" status lines from prior sessions appearing after `--resume`/`--continue`
entries.zh: 修复了`--resume`/`--continue`之后出现的先前会话中过时的“远程控制处于活动状态”状态行

entries.en: Fixed stale `installed_plugins.json` entries pointing at deleted cache directories polluting PATH
entries.zh: 修复了指向已删除缓存目录污染 PATH 的过时`installed_plugins.json`条目

entries.en: Fixed MCP stdio servers receiving corrupted arguments when `CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX` is set and an argument contains spaces or shell metacharacters
entries.zh: 修复了当设置`CLAUDE_CODE_SHELL_PREFIX`并且参数包含空格或 shell 元字符时 MCP stdio 服务器接收损坏的参数

entries.en: Fixed sub-agent progress summaries missing the prompt cache (~3× `cache_creation` reduction)
entries.zh: 修复了缺少提示缓存的子代理进度摘要（~3×`cache_creation`减少）

entries.en: Fixed `/plugin update` never detecting new versions of npm-sourced plugins
entries.zh: 修复了 `/plugin update` 永远不会检测到 npm 来源的插件的新版本

entries.en: Fixed sub-agent summaries firing repeatedly while a sub-agent's transcript is static, capping worst-case token cost on idle sub-agents
entries.zh: 修复了子代理摘要在子代理的记录是静态时重复触发的问题，从而限制了空闲子代理的最坏情况令牌成本
